info.title: Ridei Circuits API
info.description: Catálogo de circuitos: venues, tracks y layouts, con deduplicación y administración.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administración del catálogo. Requiere un token con rol ADMIN.

tags.name: Venues
tags.description: Catálogo de circuitos para cualquier usuario autenticado: búsqueda y propuestas.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked access token (no body)

403.description: The token does not have role ADMIN (no body)

404.description: Venue, track or layout not found

409.description:
Conflict. `code` indicates the case:
- `POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_VENUE`: nearby venue(s) with a similar name; `candidates` sorted by similarity. Resend with `confirmedNotDuplicate: true` to create it anyway.
- `DUPLICATE_TRACK` / `DUPLICATE_LAYOUT`: `candidates[0]` is the existing item.
- `CATALOG_ITEM_MERGED`: the item was merged; operate on the canonical one.
- `CATALOG_ITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS` / `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION`: concurrent write; reload and retry.

503.description: ridei-identity unreachable to validate the token; retry later

get.description: Free text (matches words of venue and track names, accents/case/punctuation ignored), country, discipline and proximity (lat + lon + radiusKm together). All optional. Paginated (page from 0, size ≤ 100, default 20). Ordered by similarity, then distance, then name. Excludes merged venues.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked access token (no body)

503.description: ridei-identity unreachable to validate the token; retry later

post.description: Creates a venue with its first track and, optionally, its first layout (it becomes the default). 201 CREATED if new. 200 EXISTING_BY_EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID if a venue with the same externalPlaceId exists (always, even with confirmedNotDuplicate). 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_VENUE with candidates if a venue < 2 km away has a similar name: show them and resend with confirmedNotDuplicate = true if none matches. The proposer is taken from the token.

201.description: Created (outcome = CREATED); Location header points to the venue

200.description: A venue with the same externalPlaceId already existed (outcome = EXISTING_BY_EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID)
